name: measure_fill_simple_4_4
notes: D1/D4: typing `|` (a trigger char for everyone now) asks for the cursor tick, then offers one snippet that replaces the typed `|` with rests + ` |`. Derivation with the frozen core: scan_time_signature(doc) = 4/4 (no #timesig), is_after_bar_line(line, cursor) = false (the text before the just-typed `|` does not end with a bar line — TS passes column-1, i.e. the `|` itself is excluded), measure_remainder_ticks(24, 24, 4/4) = 96-24 = 72, ticks_to_mml_rest(72, 24) = "r2." ⇒ insert "r2. |".

name: measure_fill_ctrl_space_4_4
notes: §3.1-26: measure fill is invocation-independent, so the Ctrl+Space path (`trigger: null`) is identical to the happy-path `|` trigger case.

name: measure_fill_not_offered_inside_comment
notes: D4: the comment guard now runs BEFORE measure fill (TS ran the fill first — that was the bug). A `|` typed inside a comment must not even request the cursor tick, so the plan is Done with an empty exclusive list.

name: measure_fill_tick_unavailable
notes: D4/D20: when the host cannot supply a tick (compile failed / no compiler), the provider returns an exclusive EMPTY list — no fall-through to the command fallback.
